The big-eyed anime/manga style was popularized by Japanese artist and animator Osamu Tezuka, famous in the US for creating Astro Boy. He was basically Japan's Jack Kirby and Walt Disney rolled up into one. Tezuka copied the Disney style of character design and this is where the anime look comes from. This is why if you go on youtube and look up old Astro Boy cartoons they look like a Disney cartoon from the 1930s.

Tezuka was so influential that pretty much every artist and animator in Japan since him uses some variation on his style. The Chinese and Koreans also draw and animate in this style because of Japanese imports into their countries.

Basically, it is true that the anime/manga look is a cartoon/caricature for Asians, but it is also true that the style was derived from Disney who drew cartoon characters based on white features.
